title.en: AN ACT EMPOWERING THE MILITARY GOVERNOR AND HIS PROPER SUBORDINATES TO ORGANIZE TOWN GOVERNMENTS NOT ALREADY ORGANIZED IN PROVINCES TO WHICH THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT HAS NOT BEEN EXTENDED.
title.orig: AN ACT EMPOWERING THE MILITARY GOVERNOR AND HIS PROPER SUBORDINATES TO ORGANIZE TOWN GOVERNMENTS NOT ALREADY ORGANIZED IN PROVINCES TO WHICH THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT HAS NOT BEEN EXTENDED.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00100_1901_html.txt

text.en:
In all provinces to which the provisions of the Provincial Government Act have not been
extended, the Military Governor, or his proper subordinates, shall have power to organize town governments
not already organized under General Order Number Forty, series of nineteen hundred, Office of the Military
Governor of the Philippine Islands, or the Municipal Code, in accordance with the provision of General
Order Number Forty-three, series of eighteen hundred and ninety-nine, Headquarters Division of the
Philippines. Such organization shall be provisional and shall remain in force only until the Commission shall
establish a municipal government in accordance with the terms and provisions of the Municipal Code.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 9, 1901.
